content.title: Justin Bieber Watches His Documentary with Son Jack Blues, 19 Months, in Sweet New Photos Shared by 'Cool Mom' Hailey Bieber
content.text: Hailey Bieber and Jack Blues; Justin Bieber and Jack Blues. Credit : Hailey Bieber/Instagram (2) NEED TO KNOW Hailey Bieber is embracing her "cool mom" lifestyleIn a Sunday, April 6 Instagram post, the Rhode Beauty founder, 29, shared some recent pictures of her son Jack Blues, 19 months, whom she shares with husband Justin BieberIn the snaps, the doting mom gave a glimpse into her "cool mom life" showing herself holding her son at the 32-year-old musician's recent concert, cuddling with him on the couch, indulging in a sweet treat and playing with stickers Hailey Bieber is embracing her "cool mom" lifestyle. In a Sunday, April 6, Instagram post, the Rhode Beauty founder, 29, shared some recent pictures of her son Jack Blues, 19 months, whom she shares with husband Justin Bieber. In the snaps, the doting mom gave a glimpse into her "cool mom" life, showing herself holding her son at the 32-year-old musician's recent concert, cuddling with him on the couch, indulging in a sweet treat and playing with stickers. In the last snap, Hailey showed the "Sorry" singer and his son spending some quality time together. The father-son pair sat outside together as they watched his 2011 documentary Never Say Never. "Not regular mom, cool mom," she captioned the post. The couple welcomed their little boy into the world on Aug. 22, 2024. Hailey recently shared an adorable photo with her son back in March. The model uploaded a carousel of pictures to her Instagram account, including a sweet image of her cuddling her son. The mom of one had her brunette hair tied back and wore a cozy hooded sweatshirt as she nuzzled her head into Jack's, showing a glimpse of his short, fair hair in the candid snap. Hailey simply captioned her post: “Different faces and places 🌻.” Related Stories Back in February, the proud mom sat down with influencer Jake Shane during an episode of his podcast Therapuss with Jake Shane, where she opened up about her journey as a mom. During the conversation, Hailey shared with Shane, 26, that the then-16-month-old "talks a lot about basketball." "He says basketball all the time," Hailey shared. "I went to get him up from his nap today, and he was like 'basketball.' He's just. It's insane. So funny." "He also just started saying please. He knew how to sign please for a really long time. So if I would say, hey, 'say please', he would go this, as please," she added while performing the American Sign Language gesture for "please." When Jack isn't signing or speaking, Hailey said the toddler is following in his father's footsteps and singing his 2010 hit song "Baby." “He’s been saying, ‘Baby, oh, baby, oh,’ ” Hailey said, copying her son's voice. "Literally in the last two days." Another interest that Jack Blues and the Swag artist share, according to Hailey, is their love for sports. “He’s running,” she told Shane. “He’s kicking a soccer ball. He’s throwing a soccer ball. He’s into all of it.”
